cartas.texto: 🌪️ REGO detects a dust storm. For 3 sols less light will reach the panels.

opciones.resultado: The motors that cover the panels used battery, but the panels won't get dirty.
The panels filled up with dust: they will produce less until you clean them.

cartas.dato: In 2018 a dust storm that covered all of Mars left the Opportunity rover without power. Dust also shut down the InSight lander in 2022.

cartas.texto: ⚙️ MOXIE is making a strange noise.

opciones.texto: Turn it off and check it
opciones.resultado: MOXIE was off for a while: it made less oxygen, but now it works fine.
It ran under strain and used much more energy than usual.

cartas.dato: MOXIE, on board the Perseverance rover, showed that we can make oxygen from the CO₂ in the Martian air.

cartas.texto: 💧 There's a small leak in the water tank!

opciones.resultado: You sealed the leak, but the tools used battery.
Water was lost during the night.

cartas.dato: On the International Space Station about 98% of the water is recycled, even sweat and urine!

cartas.texto: 🪨 You found a very heavy reddish rock near the base.

opciones.resultado: It had iron: you turned it into a useful part, but the furnace used battery.
You kept it. You used no energy, but you didn't gain anything either.

cartas.dato: Mars is red because its soil has a lot of iron oxide: it's rusty!

cartas.texto: 🌱 The plants in the greenhouse look weak. They need more light.

opciones.resultado: The plants grew stronger, but the lights used battery.
Some leaves wilted: there's a bit less food.

cartas.dato: In the Veggie experiment on the ISS, plants grow under red, blue and green LED lights: that's why the greenhouse looks pink.

cartas.texto: 🥶 Tonight the temperature outside will drop to -75 °C.

opciones.resultado: You slept warm and cozy, but the heating used battery.
Your body used more energy to stay warm: you ate more.

cartas.dato: Nights on Mars can drop below -70 °C. The Curiosity rover measures it with its REMS weather station.
